name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 43 – Am 51
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 43a. Calls for the budget to include the target of allocating at least 0.7 % of EU Member States’ gross domestic product to official development assistance, in line with the objective set out in UN General Assembly Resolution 2625 (XXV) of 24 October 1970 and contained in paragraph 43 of the Declaration on the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development;
